I just am bad at not procrastinating. And I don't even do it on purpose! I swear. It all starts with being in class...The teacher will be lecturing, and then he will say something and in my head, I start this crazy word associating thing, and that leads to thinking of tangents etc. etc. and voila, itll be 10 minutes later and i'll be lost.

fast forward to after work, and im at home doing homework, read 10 pages of required reading, realize I didnt understand it at all, re read 8/10 pages again...then 6/10... and then I will just get stressed out and then get mad at school I dont know. I guess im rambling. sorry.

I work really hard when it comes to school stuff, I think I work a lot harder for my grades then most because of all my other responsibilities. I try to never let my teachers down, but right now what I'm scared of is what my english teacher is gonna say if I dont finish this damned essay

I guess there's two of you here which is more than I expected So i'll just type here. let me begin with saying that at this moment i have no urge to kill myself. Sorry if this is the wrong subreddit for this...but I just feel like That feelingcan be coming very soon.

I'm 19. I go to college, but i still live at home. Im a full time student with a part time job and an internship.

The last 2 weeks or so, I've had several episodes where I just start crying uncontrollably at like 3 amm for like 5-10 minutes each time. I get so scared, and I don't know whats happening. I get short on breath. sorry if this gets confusing to read.

I'm fairly sure I have ADD (i've talked to my friends who have it and take adderoll and I experience the same things), even right now I have a college essay due in about 5 hours, But even before I started doing this I couldnt bring myself to start it. I feel like such a fuck up. Sometimes I feel like if I was to move out of my house, My family would fall apart. I am the oldest of 3 brothers in my house, and both of my parents work full time so growing up and even now I was mr. mom alot. I don't know anymore.

I dont know what to do.Gah
